personal.preferred_title: Senior Data Engineer | Python, SQL, ETL/ELT, Relational Databases & Data Quality

summary: Senior Data Engineer with 20+ years of enterprise technology experience across Python, SQL, Oracle, relational databases, PySpark/Spark, ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehouses, data marts, data quality, operational support, monitoring, documentation, Agile delivery, and governance-aware enterprise reporting. Strong background designing and supporting data workflows that ingest from databases, files, APIs, and monitoring platforms; transform raw operational data into trusted analytics datasets; optimize SQL/reporting layers; and support incident management for production data flows. Best aligned to enterprise data engineering roles requiring Python, SQL, relational databases, ETL/ELT, data modeling, operational support, monitoring, documentation, mentoring, and secure/scalable delivery; Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps, T-SQL, SSIS/Informatica/Kafka/MuleSoft are positioned carefully as transferable or adjacent areas rather than overstated production ownership.

experience.title: Senior Capacity & Data Engineer
bullets: Built Python/Pandas/PySpark and SQL ETL pipelines ingesting telemetry from 6,000+ infrastructure endpoints and transforming raw operational data into curated datasets for reporting, analytics, forecasting, validation, and decision support.

Designed AWS and warehouse-backed data platform components using S3, AWS Glue, Athena, Amazon Redshift, Oracle, SQL, and PySpark to support scalable ingestion, transformation, querying, and downstream analytics.

Developed data extraction, transformation, and loading workflows from monitoring platforms, relational databases, files, and operational feeds into reporting datasets, data marts, and analytics-ready structures.

Implemented data quality and reconciliation practices across BMC TrueSight/TSCO, CA Wily/APM, AppDynamics, Oracle, and AWS-backed reporting layers to improve accuracy, completeness, consistency, and trust in outputs.
Optimized complex SQL queries, Oracle schemas, Redshift workloads, indexes, views, partitioning patterns, and reporting data models for performance, maintainability, and cost-aware processing.

Provided operational support and incident investigation for data pipelines and reporting flows, including source-feed issues, missing or late data, failed outputs, latency symptoms, and downstream reporting discrepancies.
Documented data flows, source mappings, metric definitions, transformation rules, validation checkpoints, runbooks, support procedures, and technical designs to improve visibility and reuse.

Partnered with infrastructure, analytics, application, engineering, governance, and business teams to refine requirements, define acceptance criteria, explain issues, and deliver reliable enterprise data assets.

Analyzed application behavior under load to identify throughput limits, SQL/JDBC bottlenecks, CPU, memory, thread, and garbage-collection issues.
Documented test results, expected behavior, defects, risks, and remediation recommendations for engineering and release teams.

Built CICS, MQ Series, XML messaging interfaces, and DB2-backed components in a government modernization environment.
